claim: Wall cstat 1 (blocking) and 64 (hitscan) are clip masks only; the wall pass never reads them. A two-sided wall with either bit and no drawn band (no step, not masked) is an invisible fence. A two-sided wall draws a middle only when masked (cstat&48 == 16, from over_picnum) or one-way (32); one carrying both 16 and 32 is drawn as one-way, never masked.
evidence: NBlood/source/build/src/engine.cpp:4685-4686 (classicDrawBunches) masked deferral only when (cstat&48)==16; :4938-4940 one-sided or one-way walls draw picnum / overpicnum
use: Give a blocking two-sided wall something to see (a masked over_picnum, a step) unless the fence is meant to be invisible; render_slots.wall_draw says which band each wall draws.

checked.how: Read NBlood build/src/clip.cpp:1491 in clipmove (from :1481): dawalclipmask = cliptype & 65535; build/include/build.h:225-226 CLIPMASK0 (1<<16)+1, CLIPMASK1 (256<<16)+64; engine.cpp:4685-4686 in classicDrawBunches (from :4498): maskwall deferred only when (cstat&48)==16; :4938-4940 'nextsectnum < 0 || (wal->cstat&32)' draws picnum or overpicnum as a one-way wall, so 16|32 is drawn one-way.
